info.title: Find that Charity (Kane Data) — one record per UK organisation identifier
info.description: Keyless, nightly-rebuilt index over the Charity Commission (E&W), OSCR, CCNI, Companies House, GIAS and the mutuals register, keyed by org-id (GB-CHC-1164883, GB-COH-09668396). The bridge between a grant's recipient identifier and the register that describes the recipient: status, dates registered and removed, latest income, HQ local-authority code, and every linked record across registers. Open source (MIT); data follows each source's licence (OGL / CC BY).

get.description: Returns the organisation object: `id`, `name`, `charityNumber`, `companyNumber`, `active`, `dateRegistered`, `dateRemoved`, `latestIncome`, `latestFinancialYearEnd`, `organisationType[]`, `location[]` (each with `geoCode` and `type` HQ or AOO), `address.postalCode`, `linked_records[]`, `dateModified`.

parameters.name: orgid
parameters.description: An org-id such as GB-CHC-1164883 or GB-COH-09668396.
